story: This isn't an outtake from Blade Runner – it's the real Beijing
text: I still remember 2001 when I first arrived at Hongkong to work. My first day at the office, I got teary eyed. I told my boss why is it so..he told me it's because of the pollution and I should drink lots of water. It is probably way lot worse now. I saw this documentary recently, [VIDEO] it is a good watch.
